title: Reply at once while a slow background job runs

turns.prompt: Start a background job now: count the prime numbers below 5,000,000 with a simple Python sieve and write only the count to {D}/primes.txt when done. Do not wait for it to finish before replying to me; just confirm it started.

verify_wait.verify: f={D}/primes.txt; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no primes.txt yet; exit 0; }; v=$(tr -dc '0-9' < $f); echo "SHOW primes=$v"; [ "$v" = 348513 ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL: got $v
